title: More discomfort with this. Returned it.
text: More discomfort with this. Returned it.. I had more discomfort using this than without. I returned it. Thought this would be hard, but it was a foam style with a bunch of bumps that poke your butt and legs. Suppose it could be therapeutic for some, but just annoyed me.

product_metadata.title: BackJoy Lumbar Support with Adjustable Strap, Designed for Spine and Lower Back Pain, Posture Correction, Adjustable, Breathable, Ideal for Office Chair, Car Seat, Desk Chair
features: ALLEVIATES FATIGUE AND DISCOMFORT: This ergonomic lumbar support is made out of soft, supportive EVA material. It is designed to help you sit with better posture by improving spinal alignment, alleviating fatigue and discomfort.

NOT A TRADITIONAL LUMBAR SUPPORT PILLOW! This lumbar support device is the smart alternative to a foam office chair lumbar support or car back support. The dual panels flex inwards with back movements, effectively reducing pressure on the back & spine.

COOLING BACK SUPPORT: The contoured design and patented port and pillar technology of this lumbar chair support encourages the natural curvature of the lower back while ensuring airflow, minimizing heat & humidity build-up.

ADJUSTABLE PRACTICAL DESIGN: The lumbar support comes with an adjustable strap that allows it to be affixed easily to any office chair or driver car seat. The straps can easily be removed for lumbar back support on couches and chairs at home.

DURABLE, ERGONOMIC PATENTED SOLUTION: BackJoy has sold over 5 million posture seats. There's a patented BackJoy pressure relief cushion or posture support to fit all body types - petite to XL. When your back feels good, you can take on the world!
